player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Plelere {player_id} eChopsticks. Loko u huma, khetha un’we:
  + Attaka:  '[attack M O]'  loko M=lerato ra wena (0 kuya na 1), O=lerato ra mpfana wena (0 kuya na 1).
    - Swilo swa mpfana wena swa lerato swa wena swi va kuya; loko swi fika 5, swi va 0.
  + Hlula:   '[split L R]'  ku endla swilo swa wena swi va kuya kuva malende na marhavi (malende + marhavi = swilo swa wena).
Tshama na ku rhamba hi komando yin’we.

invalid_move.split_sum: Nhlayo ya ku avana yi fanele ku va {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Swiphemu swi fanele ku cinca ndlela leyi u fambisaka voko ra wena ha yona.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Khomelo ra masango. Nisa “[attack M O]” kuya na “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} i attaka lerato la P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: leri tlhela eka {opp_val} ku ya eka {new_val}.

outcome.draw: Mpimo wa ku jikela wu fikeleriwile.
